Let me inspire you:

Learn to make 5R a week on average. Risk 2%. Work for 56 weeks.

Then solve the equation 5000 usd * ((1+0,02*5)^56) = X

By now you should know the potential of trading. If that does not inspire you... nothing will.
posts.fa:

یاد بگیر به‌طور میانگین هفته‌ای 5R بسازی. 2% ریسک کن. 56 هفته کار کن.

بعد این معادله را حل کن: 5000 usd * ((1+0,02*5)^56) = X

تا حالا باید پتانسیل معامله‌گری را فهمیده باشی. اگر این به تو انگیزه ندهد… هیچ چیز نمی‌دهد.

Though trader has to be tough as fu#k mentally to deal with it.

Another thing is liquidity.. if account has too many zeros.. probably
it is much harder to get filled at exact places hence why we study price
action and try to read what is happening. Price is always pushed to
liquidity pools so the big guys can get filled. So trading style would
change a bit and maybe it would be harder to extract so much R from
every single trade.

Hello IF,

I think I am onto something here, I think I underestimated the importance of PAZs.

Assumption: I am able to draw PAZs CORRECTLY, then I would be able to...

1)... define my targets very precise, as I already know, that if price
pierces a PAZ, it wants to travel through after a retrace.

2) ...(more important to me right now) define if an Engulf is really an
Engulf, because if price engulfs a low, but does NOT pierce the next PAZ
it is not an Engulf, but a Fakeout!

Please guys drop me a single line if I am correct here.

Thank you very much!
posts.fa:
سلام IF،

فکر می‌کنم چیزی را کشف کرده‌ام؛ فکر می‌کنم اهمیت PAZ‌ها را دست‌کم گرفته بودم.

فرض: اگر بتوانم PAZ‌ها را درست بکشم، آن‌وقت می‌توانم…

1)… اهدافم را خیلی دقیق تعیین کنم، چون از قبل می‌دانم اگر قیمت یک PAZ را سوراخ کند، بعد از یک اصلاح می‌خواهد از آن عبور کند.
